Commentary.Commentary: The end-over batting heroics have totally overshadowed the brilliant start Holder gave to his team by picking up two quick wickets. Miguel Cummins got three to his name but went for plenty in the process. West Indies will now hope for the Gayle storm to wreck havoc and Evin Lewis to go berserk as well, as that seems to be their best option to chase this mammoth total down. There is rain forecast in the second half and that will play a part as well. Join us in a while for it.

Blistering knocks at the end of the innings have helped England post a massive total on the board. The hosts were struggling at 74-3 but the 132-run stand between Root and Stokes helped them steady the ship. Both of them scored fifties to set the platform but could not capitalize on it. A late surge from Mooen Ali took the game completely away from the visitors as he blasted a fantastic 102 off just 57 balls. Woakes also supported him ably as they both smacked 117 runs together at a lightening pace for the 8th wicket.

FOUR! Edged for a  boundary! Doesn't matter how they come! Full ball outside off, Rashid looks to hit it through the off side, ends up getting a thick edge past the keeper, as the ball races away to the fence. Back-to-back boundaries to end the innings. Handy runs for the hosts. ENGLAND END ON 369/9!
FOUR! Effective runs these! Taylor bowls it very full outside off, Rashid opens the face of the bat and guides it through third man. The ball races away to the fence.
Bowls it around off, driven through mid off for a run.
This bowled outside off, Willey looks to play at that but misses the ball completely.
Very full delivery outside off, Adil guides it to third man for a run.
WIDE! Bouncer over head high, Rashid misses the pull. Wide signaled.
ADIL RASHID is the last man in.

OUT! Taylor's footie skills come to the fore! He bowls a yorker around off, Willey digs it out beside the track. The batsmen risk a quick run but Jerome runs towards the ball and kicks it with the left foot onto the stumps to catch Plunkett short of the crease. That's a run saved and the number 11 will be on strike next ball.
Taylor runs in to bowl without the ball in hand! The ball was in the umpire's pocket. Wonder whether it was deliberate or they forgot. Irrespective of that, everyone has a good laugh.
JEROME TAYLOR to bowl the final over.
FOUR! Plunkett bashes this powerfully! Nurse bowls a full toss around middle, Liam slogs it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
DAVID WILLEY comes in next.

OUT! Ali's luck runs out finally but not before doing the damage! He picks out the fielder perfectly this time. Nurse loops it up outside off, Ali hits it powerfully down the ground. The ball travels only as far as Holder at long off, who pouches this catch to end the bearded batsman's stay at the crease. End of a top, top knock. He's changed the picture of the game as it was when he walked in to bat. 102 off just 57 balls itself shows the volume of this knock. He walks off to a well-deserved applause from the crowd. Take a bow, son!
This ball is played through mid-wicket for a single.

Dropped! Would you believe it? Nurse calls for it, gets there and puts down a sitter this time! He bowls it around off, Ali gets a top edge as he looks to smash it out of the park. The ball goes behind the bowler who backpedals and settles underneath it nicely. Tries to gobble it with a reverse cup but the ball spills out. Moeen Ali gets lucky a third time unlike Ashley Nurse. The first chances were very difficult but no excuses for this one.

Dropped! Yet again by Nurse! This is floated around off, Ali comes down and smashes it straight down a bit aerially. Nurse dives to his right, gets a hand to it but puts it down. It would have been the catch of the match, had he taken it. Ali survives to hammer more!
Floats it around off, Plunkett comes down and plays it to long on for a run.
Surprise! ASHLEY NURSE to bowl the 49th over.
Full ball outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
This is driven to long on for a run.

SIX! 3rd ODI century for Moeen Munir Ali! And how does he get there? With a biggie! This has been an aggressively dominating knock from him today. Coming back to the delivery, it was full around middle and leg, he just thumps it over mid-wicket for the maximum result.
Bowled outside off, Moeen looks to hit that but misses.
SIX! Ali and the saga of maximums continue! Short ball around middle and leg, Ali pulls it with disdain for a biggie. He moves into the 90s with that.
Bowled outside off, driven through covers for a run.
MIGUEL CUMMINS is back for a bowl.
This is flicked towards mid-wicket for a run. Liam gets off the mark.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Plunkett fails to flick that. Wide signaled.
LIAM PLUNKETT comes in next.

OUT! The drop doesn't prove too costly in the end! Full ball outside off, Woakes looks to go over covers but the ball travels only as far as the fielder in the deep. Powell takes a comfortable catch to end the all-rounder's stay at the crease. End of a 117-run stand! Chris has played his part well there.

SIX! Excellent effort by Nurse at the fence! It is a short ball around off, Woakes fetches the pull and hits it towards long on. Ashley there rushes to his left, leaps and takes the catch but as his momentum carries him over the ropes, he cannot keep the ball in the area of play and takes it with him over the ropes.
This is bowled outside off, Woakes looks to play at that but misses.

Dropped! Ali of all the persons! Gayle the culprit. A low full toss outside off, Moeen slices it straight to backward point where the fielder fluffs an easy chance. He has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. One run is the end result.
This is bowled outside off, Woakes cuts it through cover-point for a run.

FOUR! And now the West Indies' fielding is giving him runs! Full ball around off, Ali hits it aerially towards long on. Samuels in the deep, stands his ground to make the stop. But, the force on the ball is such that he is not able to stop it cleanly and concedes a boundary. The Windies have been very poor in the field today. Back-to-back 25-run overs for England, courtesy Moeen Ali!
Full ball around off, Ali lofts it towards long off for a brace.

SIX! 100-run stand between Woakes and Ali! Moeen has smashed 6 biggies in the last 8 balls he has faced! He is having sixes as an afternoon snack! Another full delivery around off and middle, Ali bashes it over long on for a huge hit. How crucial this stand is turning out to be!
SIX! Moeen's hitting sixes for fun at Bristol! This is a full ball outside off, Ali clears his front leg and smashes this over long off for a biggie.
SIX! Bowler changes, result doesn't! Holder comes round the wicket and bowls a length ball around off. Ali accepts the offering and just thumps this over square leg for a maximum!
This ball around off is driven through covers for a run.

SIX! No.3 in the over! Cummins lands it on a length around middle, Moeen Ali connects the heave yet again. The ball flies high and handsomely over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie! He's just tore into Cummins here. 25 runs off this over!
FOUR! Streaky but effective! This is another low full toss outside off, Ali has a swing at that and gets a outside edge. The ball runs past the diving keeper for a boundary.
A low full toss outside off, Moeen guides it towards third man. The fielder there dives and keeps them down to a brace.

SIX! What a way to bring up a 6th ODI fifty! Flair and style in that shot! Another length ball around off, Ali swings it over mid-wicket for another humongous hit. He's looked very fluent throughout his stay at the crease.
SIX! A bit of Yuvraj Singh in that stroke! Length delivery around off, Ali takes his front foot out of the way and strikes it cleanly over wide long on for a maximum.
Spears this in line of the stumps, driven to long on for a run.
MIGUEL CUMMINS is brought back into the attack.
Bowled in line of the stumps, Chris plays it towards deep mid-wicket where Powell fumbles, but doesn't concede more than a run.
In the air... but falls just short of the deep mid-wicket fielder! Length ball around middle, Woakes hits it aerially, where the ball doesn't carry to the fielder. They take two.
This ball is played through mid off for a run.
Bowls this in line of the stumps, Chris flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length ball outside off, Chris cuts it through point. Bishoo in the deep does well and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Low full toss around leg, Moeen lofts it towards long on for one run.

FOUR! Mid off is up and that is a very safe shot to bring up the 50-run stand between these two! Taylor bowls it fuller around off, Woakes hits it over the fielder there and collects a boundary for himself. The ball landed just in front of the fence there. This is a vital stand and England would love them to carry on for a good flourish towards the end.
Short ball around leg, Ali pulls it through square leg for a run.
Bowls it full around middle, flicked away through mid-wicket for a run.

Proper cricket shots get Ali the runs that he wants at a quick rate. Hence he doesn't really need to have wild slogs that result in dot balls at this stage of the game. He can bide his time at the crease and cut loose in his own style.
Spears a very full ball around middle and off, Ali pushes it down to long on for a single.
Full ball outside off, Ali comes down the track and has a swing, but he misses the ball completely.

Edged but effective! Not one of his most elegant strokes, quips Atherton on-air! Length delivery around off, Ali has a wild swing at that. Gets the top edge that flies through third man for a boundary.
Comes round the wicket and bowls a length delivery around middle, Ali pulls it through square leg for a run.
Well, this short got less runs than it deserved! Full ball outside off, Woakes drives it through covers, but straight to the fielder in the deep. Only one run available there.
Length ball outside off, Woakes cuts it towards third man for another brace.
Well done Samuels! Holder bowls it full outside off, Chris drives it through covers. The fielder in the deep does well and keeps it down to two.
And again! This time it is a fuller delivery outside off, enticing the drive. Woakes goes for the shot without any footwork and sees the ball whiz past the edge of the bat.
Play and a miss! Bowls a back of a length delivery outside off, Woakes looks to cut that but misses.
JASON HOLDER brings himself back on.
Yorker around middle, Woakes digs it out through cover-point for a single.
Short ball around leg, Ali pulls it away through square leg for one run.
Lands it on a good length around off, Ali drives it down the ground. It is intercepted by the fielder at mid off.
This delivery in line of the stumps is flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Taylor spears this down the leg side, Woakes goes for the flick but misses. The umpire stretches his arms.
This is on a length around off, Woakes defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it full around off, Ali droves it through covers for a run.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of five fielders are allowed outside the circle.
Length ball around off, defended off the back foot.
Fuller delivery around off, Ali smashes that over the bowler's head for a single towards long on.

Brilliant fielding by Ashley Nurse! Good length delivery outside off, Woakes dabs it really fine. Nurse dives to his left from short third man and saves a certain boundary for his team. A single is taken.
Length delivery around off, dabbed towards point for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Length delivery outside off, Ali camps back and pulls it brutally through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Fuller delivery outside off, driven towards covers.
Length outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven towards mid off.
Good length delivery around off, Ali defends it towards the fielder at point.

Short delivery into the batsman, Moeen Ali goes for the pull. Does not time it as he wants to and the ball falls short of the fielder at deep square leg. Lewis puts in a great effort there as he sprints to his left and dives forward. Gets hit on his shoulder and the ball ricochets towards the fielder at fine leg. The batsmen run two in the process.
On a fuller length outside off, Ali drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
JEROME TAYLOR is back into the attack.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven towards long off for a single.
Slower delivery around middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery into the pads, Ali stays in his crease and defends it.
Fuller delivery around off, driven towards the fielder at mid off.
FOUR! Streaky! Good length delivery around off, Woakes goes for a push. Gets a thick outside edge on it and the ball goes past the keeper for a boundary.
Fires a yorker in line of the stumps, Woakes digs it out towards covers for a single.
Short and down the leg side, Ali goes for the pull but it is too high for him. Surprisingly the umpire does not feel so.
FOUR! Moeen Ali gets in the act! Short delivery around off, Ali stays in his crease and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Good length delivery outside off, Ali punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery down the leg side, Woakes tries to clip it fine but only manages to get his bat to it. Gets it towards square leg for a single.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali stays tall and defends it.
Short delivery outside off, Ali punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller delivery in line of the stumps, clipped towards mid on for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Woakes fancies the cut but fails to make contact.
Fuller around off, Woakes stays in his crease to defend.
Waokes gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Fuller delivery into the pads, clipped towards long on for a single.
Shorter around off, Ali punches it through covers for a single.
Short delivery around middle and off, Woakes pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Around middle and leg, clipped towards mid on.
Fuller around off, Woakes lunges forward to defend.
Woakes gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
CHRIS WOAKES steps out to bat.

OUT! Brilliant bowling by Cummins! Darts in a fuller delivery angling into the batsman, Root tries to clip it on the leg side. Fails to make contact and he gets hit flush on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire is quick to raise his dreaded finger. Root opts for the review immediately. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Time for the Ball Tracker and it completely supports the umpire's call as it shows the ball to be crashing the leg stump. West Indies are ecstatic and this is a big, big wicket for them at an opportune time. A brilliant knock comes to an end. Root will be disappointed, though, as he did have a hundred for the taking. A chance to better his conversion rate goes abegging.
Joe Root has been adjudged LBW! He opts for the review. A very big wicket in question.
FOUR! Short delivery down the leg side, Ali goes for the pull. Gets it off the bottom half and the ball races away to the fence at fine leg.
Fuller delivery around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Good length delivery around off, Moeen tries to dab it down towards third man but fails to make contact. The ball whizzes past the outside edge.
On a length outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length around off, Ali presses forward and drives towards the fielder at covers.
Short delivery around off, punched through covers for a single.
Fuller delivery outside off, Ali goes for the drive but fails to make contact.
Ali stays in his crease and defends it neatly.
MOEEN ALI walks out next.
Drinks have been taken.

OUT! Cummins strikes! Buttler has no clue about it. Miguel hurls it on a length around off, Jos tries to defend it but plays down the wrong line. The ball holds its line, goes past the outside edge and clips the top of off stump on its way to the keeper. Miguel is excited as he celebrates it with raising his hand up. Buttler's short stay comes to an end. England have again lost two wickets in quick succession.
Short and into the pads, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Angling into the batsman, clipped towards mid-wicket.
MIGUEL CUMMINS is back on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Buttler comes down the track and defends it neatly.
Full and angling into the pads, Buttler gets off the mark, clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller around off, driven straight towards the fielder at covers.
Root drives through point for a single.
JOS BUTTLER walks in next.

OUT! Stokes departs trying one too many! Fuller delivery outside off, Ben tries to smash it over the extra cover region. Cannot time it well and it comes off the outer half. The ball balloons towards the fielder in the deep. Evin Lewis settles under it and pouches it safely. A vibrant innings comes to an end and West Indies will be relieved. End of the 132-run stand between Root and Stokes off just 120 deliveries. First ODI wicket for Rovman Powell. Will the tourists be able to deal a few more blows quickly?
Short and wide outside off, creamed towards sweeper cover for a single.
Quicker around off, Stokes lunges forward to defend it.
Shorter around middle and off, Stokes camps back and pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Around leg, clipped towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around leg, Stokes flicks it towards long on. The fielder misfields there but England batsmen only settle for one.
SIX! Ben means business! Nurse bowls this one in the slot outside off, Stokes settles under it and smashes that over the long off region for half a dozen. Back-to-back maximums here!
SIX! Brilliant! Floated in line of the stumps, Stokes says enough of small hits as he just unleashes his blade to it. Hits it dead straight over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Good length delivery around off, Root stays in his crease and punches it towards extra cover.
Good length delivery into the pads, punched towards long on for a single.
Fuller around off, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Stokes stays deep in his crease and clips it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Length around off, punched off the back foot towards the fielder at extra cover.
Sprayed down the leg side, Stokes goes to play the reverse sweep but fails to make contact.

SIX! Woah, that's gone deep into the stands! Tossed up outside off, Root reads the line early, kneels down a touch and plays the slog sweep to perfection. Gets it over the deep mid-wicket region for half a dozen.
FOUR! Sprayed down the leg side this time, Root reads it quickly as he kneels down and sweeps it through the fine leg region for a boundary.
Drifting into the pads, Stokes camps back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Floated outside off, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Tossed around off, Root drives it back to the bowler.
100-run stand between Root and Stokes! The mainstays of the English setup have started well again. Fuller into the pads, heaved towards deep square leg for a single.
Length delivery around off, Root does not get the width this time so just manages to run it down towards the fielder at short third man.
On a fuller length outside off, Stokes comes down the track and drives it towards wide long off for a single.
Short delivery around off, dabbed towards short third man for a single.
Length delivery around off, punched towards point. The fielder there dives to his right, fumbles a bit but does not concede a single.
Good length delivery on off, Root defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Text book shot! Length delivery outside off, Root just relishes the width and smashes that through the backward point region for a boundary.
Floated around off, Stokes comes dancing down the track to defend it back to the bowler. Nurse dives to his right to make a good stop.
Spinning in from outside off, Root stays back and just pushes it towards covers for a single.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple.
Fuller on off, Stokes drills it towards wide long off for a single.
Drifting in from around off, Stokes stays back to block it.
Quicker around off, Stokes prods forward in defence.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards the fielder at backward point.
On a fuller length around off, Root lunges forward and defends it.
Angling into the pads, Root shuffles across and clips it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
Length delivery outside off, Root goes for a push. Gets an outside edge on it and the ball rolls away towards the fielder at short third man.
Length delivery around off, pushed off the outer half towards backward point. The fielder dives to stop it and the batsmen run a single.
Fuller delivery angling into the pads, clipped towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
ROVMAN POWELL is introduced to bowl.
Tosses this around off, Root drives it to long on for a run.
This ball is driven to long off for a run.
Too many occasions this has happened, says Michael Holding on-air, as he watches another misfield. It was bowled around middle, Root flicks it to mid-wicket, where the lapse allows him a run.
That is Stokes' 10th ODI fifty! This delivery around middle, is driven to long on for a run. He's looking dangerous and if he stays for any longer, West Indies would be staring at a big total.
FOUR! The Big Ben attacks and does well! Nurse floats it around off, Stokes gets down and plays the reverse sweep. The ball races through point for a boundary.
Tosses it around off and middle, Root drives it to long on for a run.
Floats it around middle. Ben blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Stokes reads that googly and plays it effectively for a boundary. It was bowled just outside off, Ben slapped it through covers.
Floats it outside off, Joe drives it through covers for a single.
Bowls it a tad shorter around middle, Stokes punches it through mid on for one run.
Another delivery around middle is punched back towards the bowler.
Lands this around middle, Ben blocks it off the back foot.
This delivery around off is cut to point.
Flights this around off, Root flicks it to mid-wicket.
Floats it around off, Ben drives it to long off for a run.
Another ball around off is blocked off the front foot onto the ground.
Loops it up around off, Stokes gets to the pitch and defends it solidly.
Beaten by the extra bounce! Nurse lands it on a length outside off, Stokes looks to cut but gets beaten.
This delivery is flicked away through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Hugeeee hit! Bishoo floats this around middle and off, Stokes charges down and smashes it over long on for a maximum. He connected that really well.
This ball is played back to the bowler.
Tosses this around off, Root plays it to long off for one run.
Serves it around off, Stokes punches it to long on for a run.
Loops it up around middle, Root sweeps it away through square leg for a single.
Nurse fires this shorter around off and middle, Root kneels down and sweeps it through square leg for a run.
A tad shorter around off, Stokes punches it to long on for a single.
Floats it around off, Root plays it towards point for a run.
Nurse lands this around middle, Root flicks it to square leg.
Lands this around off, Joe punches it towards covers.
Driven to mid off off the front foot.

24th ODI fifty for Joe Root! He's played both pacers and the spinners well so far and should look to strike a big score today. Coming to the ball, it was floated full around middle and leg, Root drove it to long on for a run.
Quicker ball around middle, Root pushes it to the left of mid on, where Gayle does well to prevent a run. Huge cheers from the audience follow that!
Flatter ball around off, Stokes pushes it to long off for a run.
Loops it around middle, Joe drives it to long on for a single.
Bishoo serves this outside off, Root cuts it straight to backward point.
Lands it a tad short around off, Stokes goes back and plays it through mid off. A slight misfield there allows him a run.
Lands it outside off, driven to covers.
This delivery is driven to long on for a run.

FOUR! Wonderful shot to bring up the 50-run stand! Nurse loops it around off, Stokes reverse sweeps it through backward point. The fielder there misfields and the ball goes through him and races away to the fence. This is an important stand for England if they are to get anywhere north of 300!
Serves this around middle, Stokes flicks it to mid-wicket.
Nurse lands this around off and middle, Joe drives it through mid on for a single.
Starts off with a ball around off, Root drives it to covers.
ASHLEY NURSE is brought into the attack.
Loops it up around middle, Root collects a run through mid-wicket.
A tad short around off, Stokes goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
Lands this around middle and leg, Root flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
This ball is driven to long on for a run.
Floats it around off, driven to long off for a run.
Bishoo lands this around middle, Stokes flicks it towards short fine leg. The fielder hurls a wild throw over the keeper. England didn't go for the extra run as there was a fielder backing up.
Back of a length ball on the pads, Stokes pulls it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Shot! Cummins bowls it on a length around middle and leg, Stokes charges down and lifts it over mid on for a boundary. The ball lands just in front of the ropes.
Bowls it around off, Stokes drives it to mid off.
Bowls it around middle, Root takes a run after flicking it through square leg.
The on-air commentators talk about Cummins' followthrough. They observe that it is abrupt as he just stops after taking a couple of steps.
Length ball around leg, Stokes pulls it through square leg for a run.
Runs in and lands it on a length around off, Root stays back and collects a run after playing it to third man.
Floats this around off and middle, Stokes goes back and punches it to mid-wicket.
Loops it around off, Root drives it to long off for a run.
Bishoo bowls this on the pads, Stokes clips it through square leg for a run.
Another short delivery around off, Joe goes back and smashes it to the left of covers. Holder makes a half-stop but is unable to prevent a single.
Lands this short around off, Root goes back and punches it towards covers. A misfield there by Holder allows the batsmen a brace.
Begins with a flatter ball around middle, Root goes back and plays it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Spin time! Wrist spinner DEVENDRA BISHOO to bowl now. He has a slip in place - Gayle.

DRINKS are on the field now! This hour of play has been sort of a tug-of-war. After the tourists managed to pick up an early wicket, the hosts managed to keep the opposition bowlers at bay. But Windies struck with two wickets in quick succession to push England on the back foot a bit. This interval would help both the sides regroup and have a go at each other again.
Length delivery on the pads, flicked through backward square leg for a single.
SIX! Top edge and it goes all the way! Cummins lands it short around leg, Root swivels and pulls it but gets it off the top edge. The ball flies over fine leg for a maximum.
Root defends this length ball from the crease.
Short ball around middle and leg, Stokes pulls it away through backward square leg for a single.
This is bowled outside off, Stokes covers the stumps and lets it go.
Back of a length ball around off, Stokes punches it back towards the bowler.
Fuller ball around the pads, Stokes turns it through square leg for a single.
This ball is played through point for a run.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Stokes looks to drive but gets an outside edge towards gully. The ball lands just short of the fielder and rolls to the right. The batsmen run one.
Lands it outside off, Root guides it to third man for a run.
FOUR! This time beats the diving point fielder to his right! Length delivery outside off, Root stays back and punches it through point for a boundary.
Huge cheers as Gayle at gully dives to stop that. It was bowled around off, Joe guided it there off the back foot.
Another ball around off that is blocked off the back foot.
Bowls it on a length around off, Stokes defends it from the crease.
Length ball around leg, he flicks it away through square leg for a run.
Miguel bowls it full outside off, Stokes drives it through covers. Before the fielder chases that down with a slide, the batsmen run three.
Lands this outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Pristine timing there! Cummins serves it on a length around middle and leg, Stokes just pushes that past mid on for a boundary. The fielder there put in the dive but couldn't prevent the run flow.
This delivery is punched towards mid on for a run.
Length ball on the pads, Stokes tucks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a brace. That's really quick running there.
This is around middle and off, Ben defends it off the back foot.
Lands it outside off, Stokes lets that go to the keeper.
All-rounder BEN STOKES strides out to the center.

OUT! Morgan is gone nicking for a golden duck! Holder lands it on a length around off, the English skipper has a feel for that. He ends up edging it which is pouched safely by Hope. West Indies have done well to pick up quick wickets here. Should look to make further inroads into the batting line-up. Eoin is going through a lean patch and that form continues for him. He's just managed 22 runs in his last 9 innings in all formats.
Slip and a gully for Morgan!
Lands it around off, Root plays it towards point for a quick run.
The English skipper, EOIN MORGAN, walks in next.

OUT! West Indies have made a terrific use of the review! Cummins bowls a full delivery around off and middle, Hales looks to defend it off the front foot but the ball sneaks through him, hitting his back pad in the process and goes to the keeper. The tourists appeal but the umpire stays put. Holder takes his time and decides to review. Replays roll in and show that the ball misses the bat. Hawk Eye shows that the ball would go on to hit the stumps. The umpire overturns his decision, Hales has to walk back! Terrific bowling results in a wicket finally! Alex was looking good and his dismissal bodes well for the visitors.
This delivery seems to have brushed the pads and gone to the keeper. The Windies players appeal but the umpire stays put. They decide to review.
Length ball on the pads, tucked to deep square leg for a single.
This delivery is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! What a shot that! Cummins spears this full around middle and leg, Hales drives it straight down the ground for a boundary. He's timing his drives perfectly so far!
Full ball on the pads, Hales flicks it to the right of fine leg for a brace. It's a wet and slippery outfield but the fielder does well there.
Begins with a very full ball outside off, Hales looks to dig it out but misses.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled by the umpire. Now a maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle. Meanwhile, MIGUEL CUMMINS is brought into the attack.
Drives this delivery to mid on.
Short ball around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Edged, just falls short! Holder bowls it a tad fuller around middle, Root looks to clip it away but gets it of the leading edge towards backward point. The fielder dives, but the ball lands in front of him and he ends up making a half-stop. The batsmen run one.
Serves it around off and middle, Hales flicks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
Beaten, courtesy extra bounce! Holder lands it back of a length outside off, Hales looks to cut that. But the ball bounces more and passes over the bat to the keeper.
Lands this on a length around middle, Joe collects a run by playing it through mid-wicket.
FOUR! Tripe! Punished! Taylor lands this short outside off, Hales camps back and slaps it over covers for a boundary. That was as disdainful as it can be!
Full ball around off, Hales plays it towards covers.
FOUR! Shot! Glorious, gracious! Taylor spears in a full ball around middle, Hales straight drives it past the non-striker for a boundary. The fielder at mid on couldn't do anything about that.
Length delivery outside off, Joe glides it to third man for a single.
FOUR! That's not the line to bowl, Taylor! He bowls it full around middle and leg, Root flicks it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Bowled around off, Root defends it from within the crease.
Length ball outside off, Hales guides it towards third man. Before the fielder there can rush to his left, they take two.
This ball around off is pushed towards point.

FOUR! A valiant effort in the deep goes to waste. Holder bowls it around middle and leg, Hales flicks it through mid-wicket. The fielder rushes there from deep square leg, puts in the dive yet fails to prevent the boundary.
Slip goes out now.
Length ball around off, punched towards covers.

Just over Bishoo! Holder bowls it on a length around off, Hales looks to drive it on the up over mid off but gets it high off the bat. The fielder there jumps but it goes just over him. Before he retrieves that, the batsmen run two.
Bowls it full around off, Hales drives it towards mid on.
FOUR! And another one! Taylor isn't helping his side by bowling such deliveries. He bowls a fuller delivery on the pads, Root clips it through square leg for another boundary. 12 runs off the over!
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Root and England! Taylor spears it short around off, Root stays back and pulls it through square leg. The ball races away to the fence in no time.
FOUR! Beautifully played! Taylor bowls it full around middle and leg, Root flicks it aerially through mid-wicket. The fielders chase but the ball races away to the fence.
Taylor serves it full around leg, Joe flicks it towards square leg.
Bowls it around off, Joe defends it towards covers.
Beaten again! Length ball outside off, Root feels for that yet again as he sees the ball fly past the edge of his bat.
Length ball around off, Joe opens the face of the bat to guide it to third man for a run. He gets off the mark with that.
Gloriously struck, but well fielded. Full ball outside off, Root cover drives that only to be fielded by the fielder there with a divee.
Beaten straightaway! Holder lands it on a length outside off, Root feels for that but gets beaten as the ball moves away ever so slightly.
JOE ROOT walks in at no.3!

OUT! Holder has come back well! He lands this on a back of a length around off, Bairstow looks to turn it away to the on side. Ends up getting a top edge that flies to the left of the bowler. Holder settles under it and pouches that safely. That ball bounced a tad more than Jonny expected. That's it for Bairstow with the bat today! West Indies should be pumped up with this early strike!

SIX! Bairstow makes full use of the opportunity to free his arms! Holder bowls it short around off, Jonny pulls it over mid-wicket for a huge hit. That went all the way. Windies should reduce giving such freebies!
Lands it on a length around middle, Hales punches it aerially to the left of mid on. They take a single. Holder has overstepped and it is a no ball. Free Hit coming up!
Length ball around middle, Bairstow plays it towards mid-wicket off the back foot and rushes across for a quick single.
A very good delivery to follow the previous one. Taylor bowls a bouncer around off, Hales looks to pull but misses. A good testing over comes to an end.
Very full delivery around middle and leg, Hales digs it out and pushes it to mid on.
Just short! Taylor serves it on a length around off, Hales gets hit high of his bat and back towards the bowler. The ball lands short of him.
Length delivery around middle and off, Hales defends it off the back foot.
Full delivery around off, Bairstow drives it straight back. Taylor gets down and makes a half-stop. As the ball rolls towards mid off, the batsmen run one.
Steams in and spears it on a length around middle and leg, Jonny misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
FOUR! Ahh! Wonderful cut shot! You don't always say this to describe the shot but it was so good. A back of a length ball outside off, Hales stays back and cuts it in front of point for a boundary.
This delivery around off is defended by getting behind the line of the delivery.
Bristol is the venue where the ball swings the most in England, as per the record in the last 10 years. West Indies will look to make the most of the conditions and pick some early wickets.
Lands it around off on a length, Holder blocks it from the crease.
Full delivery swinging away from Alex, he shoulders arms to that one and lets it go to the keeper.
Bowls it around off, Hales gets back and blocks it by showing the full face of the bat.
Short ball around off, Hales pulls it over mid on. The fielder chases down but slips a tad and concedes two runs there.
FOUR! Edged but safe! Taylor lands it on a length around off, Bairstow looks to cut but gets a leading edge through cover-point for a boundary. That's the first one of the game!
Length ball around off, pushed towards point.
Bowls it full around off, Hales flicks it through mid-wicket for a run. He wanted a second but Bairstow sends him back and rightly so.
Length delivery outside off, Alex pushes it towards point.
Fuller delivery outside off, pushed to covers.

Jaffa! But sadly it won't count! Taylor runs in and hurls a yorker on middle stump, Hales moves away to hit it but misses the ball completely to see the stumps shattered. But he is saved as it was a Free Hit!
Free Hit coming up!
Length ball outside off, Hales cuts that past backward points towards third man for a brace. It's been signaled a no ball, as Taylor has overstepped there! It was a big no ball.
Bowls it in line of the stumps, Jonny defends it showing the full face of the bat.
The Windies players are seen wearing black arm bands. It is in the memory of those who suffered due to the hurricane in the Caribbean Islands. Our thoughts are with them at this time.
Holder serves it in line of the stumps, Bairstow keeps it out off the front foot.
Lands it outside off, Bairstow pushes it towards backward point.
Full ball around off, Hales digs it out towards mid on for a run. He gets going now.
Length ball on the pads, Jonny tucks it to fine leg for a run. He's off the mark with that.
Runs in from over the wicket and bowls it on a length around off, Bairstow stands tall and blocks it from the crease.
JASON HOLDER to bowl with the second new ball from the other end. Two in slips for him.
Full ball moving away from Hales, he shoulders arms to let that go. A good over from Taylor.
Bowls it on the pads, Jonny misses the flick. The ball takes the pads and rolls towards short fine leg. The batsmen steal a leg bye. England get going!
Cannot beat backward point again! Length ball outside off, Bairstow pushes it to the right of the fielder who makes a diving stop.
Bowls it on a length around off, Jonny pushes it off the back foot to backward point.
Full ball around off, Bairstow gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to push it to the off side.
Starts off with a outswinger fuller outside off, Bairstow covers the stumps and shoulders arms.

The players and the umpires make their way out to the middle. The conditions are a bit overcast. JONNY BAIRSTOW and ALEX HALES walk out to open the innings with the bat. JEROME TAYLOR will run in with the first new ball. Two slips in place. Let's roll...
WEST INDIES PLAYING XI - Chris Gayle, Evin Lewis, Shai Hope(wk), Marlon Samuels, Jason Mohammed, Rovman Powell, Jason Holder(c), Ashley Nurse, Devendra Bishoo, Jerome Taylor, Miguel Cummins.
ENGLAND PLAYING XI - Jonny Bairstow, Alex Hales, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan(c), Ben Stokes, Jos Buttler(wk), Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Liam Plunkett, Adil Rashid, David Willey.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and choose to field.

England would be wary of the threat that the tourists possess and they would try to see to it that there's no slip-up from their end. As announced by skipper Eoin Morgan, there might be no rotation of players just for the sake of it and thus, expect them to go in with an unchanged side. It promises to be an exciting encounter. Stay with us as we get you all the live action.

Hello folks! The Gayle-storm may strike England today - that's the big happy news for West Indies going into the third ODI. Welcome to our coverage of the third game of the series, played at the County Ground in Bristol. The track is supposed to be a tad slow but that hardly matters when the opener, who has recovered from his hamstring injury, decides to cut loose. The conditions may mean that the slower bowlers stand a chance of getting some purchase from the wicket.
